title: Flux Closure Attribution & Refined Richards Reference
objective: Attribute the persistent LayeredMFP versus FullRichards redistribution/interface offsets to face-flux closure versus time integration and determine their behaviour under spatial refinement before changing the candidate solver.
attribution_questions: How different are arithmetic endpoint-K and MFP-secant face fluxes on identical frozen states?
Does substituting arithmetic-K into the reduced-order update collapse the small-dt homogeneous redistribution difference to FullRichards?
Do LayeredMFP and FullRichards approach each other under spatial refinement for the same continuous homogeneous profile?
At material interfaces, does coarse LayeredMFP agree better with a refined Richards reference than with the coarse four-layer Richards discretisation?
Does the historical SWAP SWKMEAN=7 Darcian-mean option indicate an existing alternative face-discretisation lineage that must be accounted for?

new_provenance_finding.finding: functions.f90 defines SWKMEAN=1..7; mode 7 delegates to MOD_Kavg_Szym and is described as a Darcian mean after Szymkiewicz/Warrick, using precomputed profile/grid-specific tables.
new_provenance_finding.qualification_effect: SWKMEAN=7 is a diagnostic lineage/control to investigate, not an admitted replacement reference in F-LMFP05 unless independently reconstructed and verified.
